The error occurred because R8 code shrinking is enabled on the release build (`isMinifyEnabled = true`), which strips generic `Signature` metadata and anonymous inner class definitions extending `TypeToken` unless explicitly preserved. As a result, Gson's `TypeToken` was unable to resolve the runtime generic type arguments when deserializing `List<Book>`.

The issue has been resolved by adding R8/ProGuard preservation rules to [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-B-r1/work/app/proguard-rules.pro):

- Preserved generic `Signature` attributes and annotations required for Gson reflection.
- Kept `com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken` and classes extending `TypeToken`.
- Kept the model classes in `vn.shelftap.lab.model.**` so their fields are not obfuscated during deserialization.
